# Contents insurance for the flat: four quotes

Our flat is on the second floor of a shared building, and our things are worth about £18,000. These are the quotes for one year starting on 1 March, paid in one go.

## Kestrel Home Cover

- Price for the year: £286.
- Excess: £100.
- Theft cover: the front door needs a five-lever mortice lock or a multipoint lock, and the door must be locked, not just pulled shut, whenever nobody is in. Theft cover stops if the flat is empty for more than 30 days in a row, and a claim made in that time is refused, not reduced.
- Also: any one item is covered up to £1,500.

## Birchfold Mutual

- Price for the year: £341.
- Excess: £75, rising to £200 for any theft claim made in the first 90 days of the policy.
- Theft cover: every door to the outside must have a lock to the British Standard, and any window left open while we are out voids the claim. After 14 days away the contents cover is cut to £2,000, and after 60 days away there is no theft cover at all.
- Also: bicycles are covered at home but not in the shared bike store.

## Quillon Direct

- Price for the year: £229.
- Excess: £250.
- Theft cover: we must have a burglar alarm that is serviced every year, and they may ask for the service receipt when we claim. If the alarm was switched off or faulty at the time of the theft, the claim is paid at half. There is no limit on days away.
- Also: any item worth over £800 must be listed by name.

## Aldermoor Select

- Price for the year: £398.
- Excess: £50.
- Theft cover: there are no lock or alarm rules for flats above the ground floor, so none apply to us. Theft cover is suspended once we have been away for more than 90 days in a row, and it starts again the day we come back and tell them.
- Also: accidental damage to a laptop or phone is included, up to £600.
